%1$s Tap Configure Discord OAuth for the exact setup requirements.

For direct linked-account DM reading and sending, this build needs a Discord Developer Application with Social SDK access, Public Client enabled, redirect URI %1$s, its application ID supplied as DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID, and Discord’s Android Social SDK package placed in app/discord_social_sdk. Notification Access is only an optional fallback for builds without the SDK.
